# 10 shares bought for 2,600.00 CAD, which opens a cost basis for them, and a
# 10.00 CAD bank fee with a guid of its own, which
# ..._shares_bought_fee_edited_into_a_sale.txt edits into a sale of 5 of the
# shares with `--strategy update`.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
